target.tool: Customer-verified business interface; master restrictions apply

key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Lots, results and usage decisions have process and status prerequisites. Results are reference data until a supported transfer interface is selected. Inspection plans require task-list effectivity, selected operations, characteristics, sampling and material assignments; plain PLKO rows are not an effective plan. Notifications require catalogs, partners and status decisions. Retain plant, characteristic, version and language. Verify released status, quantitative/qualitative control indicators, limits, units, inspection methods and catalog/selected-set dependencies in full-row export. Short texts are included; long texts need the native text API. Do not infer active version solely from greatest version number.
